p.i: Venio, ait ille, ad macellum : rogito pisces. indicant Caros : agninam caram, caram bubulam, Vitulinam, cetum, porcinam, cara omnia: Atque eo fuerunt cariora, as[?] non erat: Abeo illinc iratus, quoniam nihil est qui emam: Deinde egomet mecum cogitare inter vias Occepi, festo die si quid prodegeris, Profesto egere liceat, nisi peperceris.

main_text.p: μήτε ἅλας χρωννύν[?].) Nimirum aceto : Sal & ace-tum olim, pauperiorum cibus, ut norunt jam & lippi & tonsores. Alexis χωμαλίζειν[?] sic accepit.

Τὸ ψύμμα[?] Ἡπτολῆς[?] ἀρύθμως[?] διμένον[?]
ὄξει σπαίῳ χωμαλίζας[?].

Latini, intingere. Cato, Brassicam crudam si edas, in acetum intingito. Persius, Tingit olus: & passim Cornelius Celsus. Recte igitur χωννύειν[?] conuenit, si ad ἅλας tantùm referas : si ad ea quæ sequuntur, non item. Nam quis tam amens, qui ellychnium sal-tem intingi & madefieri nolit? cymino quoque aut origano parum conuenire videtur, quorum vsus est in condimentis, vt docet Athenæus : nec multo melius sequentibus vocibus· ἁλὰς[?], κέμμαζ[?] & Συ-λήμμαζ[?]. Quare puto subesse hic mendam, defideraríque verba aliquot. Lego, μήτε ἅλας χωννύειν[?], ....... μήτε ἐλλύχνιον[?]. in lacuna desideratur tale quid, μήτε χὰν τινί[?], vel χορηγεῖν[?], fortasse tamen nihil deest: sed illud χωννύειν[?] ex deprauatione veræ lectionis est natum. Ita igitur legi poteft, μήτε ἅλας χὰν τινὶ[?], μήτε ἐλλύχν[?]. Hoc posterius vt probabilius, sumus amplexi.

page.notes: Printed mark (small ornament or reference sign) before "Atque" in the verse, not transcribed. Small dot at the left margin beside "tem intingi" and a star-like mark beside the catchword "minum": printer's or scan marks, not text. Greek passages are hard to read on the scan; the Greek words marked [?] are best readings and should be checked against the original. "as" in "as non erat" is doubtful. Italic and roman distinctions in the Latin quotations are read from the scan. The dots in "......." are printed in the lacuna and kept as printed. "defideraríque" carries an acute accent on the i that may be a printing error. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
